posts.title: Mcbm will be getting a redesign
posts.description: After some longer period of time, MCBM will be finally getting a new design created with Material You.
posts.text_1: First of all, the app will now use a Material You theme, the gold standard of Android apps.
posts.heading_2: When will this update be out?
posts.text_2: I am planning to release the app in the upcoming week.
posts.text_3: When the new update rolls out, you'll also see a new name - Background music. I want to expand MCBM further than ''just'' Minecraft. I'd love to get some recommendations. The best way is to send me a link to a Spotify or YouTube playlist with 10-25 songs using the button below.
